tasks.title: Setup Project Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize the project structure with frontend and backend components, configure MySQL database, and establish core architecture with NextAuth.js for authentication.
tasks.details: Create a responsive web application frontend using a modern framework. Set up a RESTful API backend with appropriate routing structure. Configure a MySQL relational database with initial schema for users, products, orders, and market schedules. Establish project repository with proper structure for frontend and backend code. Set up development, testing, and production environments.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify successful project initialization, database connection, and basic API endpoint functionality. Ensure frontend can communicate with backend endpoints.

subtasks.title: Initialize Next.js Frontend with TypeScript and TailwindCSS
subtasks.description: Set up the Next.js project with TypeScript, configure TailwindCSS, and establish the basic folder structure following the architectural roadmap.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create a new Next.js project using `npx create-next-app@latest` with TypeScript option
2. Configure TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui for component styling
3. Set up the folder structure according to the architectural roadmap (app/, components/, lib/, services/, stores/, types/)
4. Initialize ESLint and Prettier for code quality
5. Configure Husky for git hooks
6. Create basic layout components (Header, Footer, Layout)
7. Set up a simple home page to verify the setup

Testing approach:
- Verify the project builds without errors
- Confirm TailwindCSS styles are applied correctly
- Check that the folder structure matches the architectural plan
- Ensure ESLint and Prettier are functioning as expected

subtasks.title: Configure MySQL Integration and NextAuth.js Authentication
subtasks.description: Set up MySQL database, configure NextAuth.js for authentication, and establish the connection between the frontend, backend, and MySQL.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Set up a MySQL database instance (local or managed)
2. Install MySQL client libraries and ORM (e.g., Prisma): `npm install @prisma/client prisma mysql2`
3. Initialize Prisma and configure the schema for MySQL
4. Set up environment variables for MySQL connection
5. Generate and apply Prisma migrations for initial schema (users, products, orders, market_days, etc.)
6. Install NextAuth.js: `npm install next-auth`
7. Configure NextAuth.js with MySQL adapter and providers (e.g., email, OAuth)
8. Implement authentication hooks and context for user management
9. Set up authentication API routes for NextAuth.js
10. Create basic sign-up, sign-in, and sign-out functionality
11. Configure authentication middleware for protected routes

Testing approach:
- Test user registration and login flow via NextAuth.js
- Verify authentication state persists across page refreshes
- Confirm protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
- Test database connection and user creation in MySQL

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Database Schema
subtasks.description: Create the core database schema in MySQL for users, products, orders, and market schedules according to the architectural plan.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Design the database schema for core tables: users, vendor_profiles, products, orders, order_items, market_days
2. Create and apply Prisma migration scripts for each table
3. Set up foreign key relationships between tables
4. Configure appropriate access controls and indexes for performance optimization
5. Set up initial seed data for testing
6. Document the schema design and relationships
7. Implement database triggers or use Prisma middleware for automated timestamps and other functionality

Testing approach:
- Verify all tables are created correctly with proper relationships
- Test access controls to ensure proper data access
- Confirm indexes are working as expected for query performance
- Validate that seed data is properly inserted

subtasks.title: Implement Data Layer with React Query
subtasks.description: Set up React Query (TanStack Query) for data fetching, caching, and state management, and create API services for interacting with the MySQL database.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Install React Query: `npm install @tanstack/react-query @tanstack/react-query-devtools`
2. Set up React Query provider in the application root
3. Create API service modules in the services/ directory for each entity (users, products, orders, etc.)
4. Implement custom hooks for data fetching using React Query
5. Set up optimistic updates for better user experience
6. Configure query invalidation strategies
7. Implement error handling and loading states
8. Add React Query DevTools for development environment

Testing approach:
- Test data fetching functionality for each entity
- Verify caching behavior works as expected
- Confirm optimistic updates provide a smooth user experience
- Check error handling for various failure scenarios

subtasks.title: Create API Routes and Server-Side Functions
subtasks.description: Implement Next.js API routes for custom endpoints and server-side functions that interact with the MySQL database.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create API route structure in the app/api/ directory
2. Implement authentication middleware for API routes using NextAuth.js
3. Create CRUD endpoints for each entity (users, products, orders, etc.)
4. Set up validation using Zod for API request data
5. Implement error handling and appropriate HTTP status codes
6. Create server actions for form submissions and data mutations
7. Set up rate limiting for API endpoints
8. Document API endpoints with examples

Testing approach:
- Test each API endpoint with various input scenarios
- Verify authentication and authorization are working correctly
- Confirm validation prevents invalid data
- Check error responses provide useful information

subtasks.title: Configure Development, Testing, and CI/CD Pipeline
subtasks.description: Set up development, testing, and production environments, and implement a CI/CD pipeline for automated testing and deployment.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Configure environment-specific settings for development, testing, and production
2. Set up Jest and React Testing Library for unit testing
3. Implement Playwright for end-to-end testing
4. Create test scripts and add them to package.json
5. Set up GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD service
6. Configure automated testing in the CI pipeline
7. Set up deployment workflows for different environments
8. Configure monitoring and error tracking (e.g., Sentry)

Testing approach:
- Run the test suite to verify all tests pass
- Test the CI pipeline with a sample pull request
- Verify deployment to development environment works correctly
- Confirm environment-specific configurations are applied properly

tasks.title: Implement Authentication System
tasks.description: Create a secure JWT-based authentication system with role-based access control for vendors, customers, and admins.
tasks.details: Implement user registration and login endpoints. Create JWT token generation and validation. Develop role-based middleware for access control. Build user profile models and endpoints for basic profile management. Implement password reset functionality and email verification. Create frontend components for login, registration, and profile management.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration, login, and authentication flows. Verify role-based access restrictions. Ensure JWT tokens are properly generated, validated, and refreshed.

subtasks.title: Implement User Registration Backend
subtasks.description: Create backend endpoints and database models for user registration with role selection and email verification
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create User model with fields for email, password (hashed), role (enum: vendor, customer, admin), verification status, and timestamps
2. Implement input validation middleware using a library like Joi or express-validator
3. Create registration endpoint that accepts email, password, and role
4. Implement password hashing using bcrypt
5. Generate a verification token and store it with the user record
6. Set up email service integration to send verification emails
7. Create endpoint to verify email using the token
8. Write unit tests for the registration flow, including validation, hashing, and verification
9. Test with different user roles and validation scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement Login System and JWT Token Management
subtasks.description: Create login endpoints with JWT token generation, refresh tokens, and token validation middleware
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create login endpoint that validates credentials against the database
2. Implement JWT token generation with appropriate payload (user ID, role, etc.)
3. Set up refresh token mechanism for extended sessions
4. Create token validation middleware that verifies JWT signatures
5. Implement token blacklisting for logout functionality
6. Create endpoints for token refresh and logout
7. Set up secure cookie handling for token storage
8. Write unit tests for login flow, token generation, and validation
9. Test token expiration and refresh flows
10. Implement rate limiting for login attempts to prevent brute force attacks

subtasks.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control Middleware
subtasks.description: Create middleware for protecting routes based on user roles and permissions
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design role-based permission structure for different user types
2. Create middleware that extracts user role from JWT token
3. Implement route protection based on required roles
4. Add support for fine-grained permissions within roles if needed
5. Create helper functions for checking permissions in controllers
6. Implement middleware for handling unauthorized access attempts
7. Write unit tests for the middleware with different role scenarios
8. Test integration with protected routes
9. Document the permission system for other developers

subtasks.title: Implement User Profile Management
subtasks.description: Create endpoints and models for user profile data and management
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Extend User model with profile-related fields (name, address, phone, etc.)
2. Create endpoints for retrieving user profile data
3. Implement endpoints for updating profile information
4. Add validation for profile data updates
5. Implement profile picture upload functionality
6. Create endpoints for changing email (with verification)
7. Write unit tests for profile CRUD operations
8. Test with different user roles
9. Implement proper error handling for profile operations

subtasks.title: Implement Password Reset Functionality
subtasks.description: Create secure password reset flow with email notifications
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create endpoint for requesting password reset
2. Implement secure token generation for password reset
3. Set up email service to send password reset links
4. Create endpoint for validating reset tokens
5. Implement endpoint for setting new password with token
6. Add password strength validation
7. Implement notification for successful password change
8. Create mechanism to invalidate all existing sessions after password change
9. Write unit tests for the complete password reset flow
10. Test token expiration and security edge cases

subtasks.title: Implement Frontend Authentication Components
subtasks.description: Create frontend components and services for authentication flows
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create registration form component with validation
2. Implement login form component
3. Build profile management interface
4. Create password reset request and confirmation forms
5. Implement JWT token storage in browser (secure cookies or localStorage)
6. Create authentication service for managing login state
7. Implement route guards for protected frontend routes
8. Add user role-based UI elements and navigation
9. Create logout functionality
10. Implement form validation matching backend requirements
11. Add loading states and error handling for authentication operations
12. Write unit tests for components and authentication service
13. Test the complete authentication flow from registration to logout

tasks.title: Build Vendor Profile Management
tasks.description: Develop functionality for vendors to create and manage their store profiles with basic information and images.
tasks.details: Create database models for vendor profiles. Implement API endpoints for profile CRUD operations. Develop image upload functionality for store images. Build frontend components for vendor profile creation and editing. Implement form validation for vendor information. Create vendor dashboard layout and navigation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test vendor profile creation, editing, and image upload functionality. Verify data validation and proper storage of profile information.

subtasks.title: Create Vendor Profile Database Models
subtasks.description: Design and implement database models for vendor profiles with all necessary fields and relationships
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a VendorProfile model with fields for: name, description, contact information (email, phone), address, business hours, logo, banner image, creation date, and status (active/inactive)
2. Add relationships to User model (if existing) to associate vendors with user accounts
3. Create necessary migrations to set up the database tables
4. Add indexes for frequently queried fields
5. Implement model validation rules
6. Write unit tests for the model to verify constraints and relationships
7. Document the model schema for other developers

subtasks.title: Implement Vendor Profile API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for vendor profile CRUD operations with proper authentication and validation
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create controller for vendor profile operations
2. Implement the following endpoints:
   - GET /api/vendor/profile - Retrieve vendor profile
   - POST /api/vendor/profile - Create new vendor profile
   - PUT /api/vendor/profile - Update existing vendor profile
   - DELETE /api/vendor/profile - Delete vendor profile (or mark as inactive)
3. Add authentication middleware to ensure only authorized users can access/modify profiles
4. Implement request validation for all endpoints
5. Add proper error handling and response formatting
6. Write integration tests for each endpoint
7. Document the API endpoints using OpenAPI/Swagger

subtasks.title: Develop Image Upload Functionality
subtasks.description: Create functionality for vendors to upload and manage profile images (logo and banner)
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Set up cloud storage integration (e.g., AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage) for image files
2. Create API endpoints for image upload:
   - POST /api/vendor/profile/logo - Upload vendor logo
   - POST /api/vendor/profile/banner - Upload vendor banner
3. Implement image processing functionality:
   - Validate file types (jpg, png, etc.)
   - Resize images to appropriate dimensions
   - Optimize images for web display
4. Update vendor profile model to store image URLs
5. Add image deletion functionality when profile is updated or deleted
6. Implement error handling for failed uploads
7. Write tests for image upload and processing
8. Document the image requirements and limitations

subtasks.title: Build Frontend Profile Management Components
subtasks.description: Create frontend components for vendor profile creation, viewing, and editing with form validation

Implementation details:
1. Create reusable form components for vendor profile data:

2. Implement form validation:

3. Create profile view component to display vendor information
4. Build profile edit component with pre-populated data
5. Implement API service to connect with backend endpoints
6. Add loading states and error handling
7. Write unit tests for components
8. Ensure responsive design for all screen sizes

subtasks.title: Integrate Vendor Dashboard Layout and Navigation
subtasks.description: Create vendor dashboard layout with navigation and integrate profile management components
subtasks.details:

tasks.title: Implement Product Management
tasks.description: Create functionality for vendors to add, edit, and manage their product listings with inventory status.
tasks.details: Design and implement product database models. Create API endpoints for product CRUD operations. Develop inventory status management functionality. Build frontend components for product management including forms for adding/editing products. Implement product image upload functionality. Create product listing views for vendor dashboard.
tasks.testStrategy: Test product creation, editing, and deletion. Verify inventory status updates. Ensure product images are properly uploaded and displayed.

subtasks.title: Design and implement product database models
subtasks.description: Create database schema for products with inventory tracking capabilities
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design product schema with fields for: id, name, description, price, category, vendor_id, creation_date, last_updated, inventory_count, status (active/inactive)
2. Include relationships to vendor accounts
3. Add inventory tracking fields (current_stock, low_stock_threshold)
4. Implement database migrations
5. Create model classes with appropriate validation
6. Write unit tests for model validation and relationships
7. Document the schema design and relationships

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for model validation
- Tests for database constraints
- Verify relationships between products and vendors

subtasks.title: Develop product CRUD API endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for product creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create API routes for product operations:
   - GET /api/products (list all products)
   - GET /api/products/:id (get single product)
   - POST /api/products (create product)
   - PUT /api/products/:id (update product)
   - DELETE /api/products/:id (delete/deactivate product)
2. Implement controller methods for each endpoint
3. Add vendor authentication middleware to ensure vendors can only manage their own products
4. Implement input validation and sanitization
5. Add error handling for all endpoints
6. Create response formatting for consistent API responses

Testing approach:
- API integration tests for each endpoint
- Authentication/authorization tests
- Input validation tests
- Error handling tests

subtasks.title: Implement product image upload functionality
subtasks.description: Create system for uploading, storing, and serving product images
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Set up cloud storage integration (e.g., AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage)
2. Create image upload API endpoint at POST /api/products/:id/images
3. Implement server-side image processing:
   - Validate file types (jpg, png, etc.)
   - Resize images to standard dimensions
   - Generate thumbnails
   - Optimize for web delivery
4. Update product model to store image URLs
5. Implement image deletion when products are removed
6. Add functionality to manage multiple images per product

Testing approach:
- Test image upload with various file types and sizes
- Verify image storage and retrieval
- Test image deletion
- Verify error handling for invalid uploads

subtasks.title: Develop inventory status management functionality
subtasks.description: Create system for tracking and updating product inventory levels
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Extend product API to include inventory-specific endpoints:
   - PUT /api/products/:id/inventory (update inventory count)
   - GET /api/products/low-stock (get products below threshold)
2. Implement inventory update logic with transaction support
3. Create inventory history tracking for audit purposes
4. Add notifications for low stock items
5. Implement batch inventory update functionality
6. Create inventory reports generation
7. Add automatic status changes based on inventory (e.g., mark as out of stock)

Testing approach:
- Test inventory updates with concurrent requests
- Verify low stock detection
- Test inventory history tracking
- Verify notification system for low stock

subtasks.title: Build frontend product management interface
subtasks.description: Create user interface components for vendors to manage their products

Implementation details:

- Integration tests for form submission
- User acceptance testing
- Cross-browser compatibility testing
- Responsive design testing

tasks.title: Develop Product Browsing and Search
tasks.description: Create product discovery functionality with browsing, basic search, and category filtering.
tasks.details: Implement API endpoints for product listing and filtering. Create search functionality with basic text matching. Develop category and vendor filtering capabilities. Build frontend components for product browsing, search interface, and filter controls. Create product detail view component. Ensure responsive design for various screen sizes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test product browsing, search functionality, and filtering. Verify product details are displayed correctly. Ensure performance with larger product datasets.

subtasks.title: Implement Product Listing API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Create backend API endpoints for retrieving product listings with pagination and basic sorting
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design RESTful API endpoints for product listing (/api/products)
2. Implement pagination with limit and offset parameters
3. Add sorting functionality (by price, name, date added)
4. Create database queries to efficiently retrieve product data
5. Include essential product fields in response (id, name, price, image, short description)
6. Add proper error handling and validation
7. Document API endpoints with Swagger/OpenAPI

Testing approach:
- Unit test database queries and business logic
- Integration test API endpoints with sample data
- Verify pagination works correctly with different page sizes
- Test sorting functionality with various sort parameters
- Validate response format and structure

subtasks.title: Develop Search Algorithm and API
subtasks.description: Implement text-based search functionality with an API endpoint for searching products
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a search endpoint (/api/products/search)
2. Implement basic text matching algorithm for product names and descriptions
3. Add relevance scoring to prioritize matches in product names over descriptions
4. Support partial word matching and case insensitivity
5. Optimize database queries for search performance
6. Return search results with highlighting of matched terms
7. Include pagination for search results

Testing approach:
- Test search functionality with various query terms
- Verify partial matching works correctly
- Test with special characters and edge cases
- Benchmark search performance with large datasets
- Validate relevance scoring with different search scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement Category and Vendor Filtering
subtasks.description: Add filtering capabilities to product listing and search APIs based on categories and vendors
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Extend product listing and search APIs to accept filter parameters
2. Implement database queries for filtering by category, subcategory, and vendor
3. Allow multiple filter selections (e.g., multiple categories)
4. Create an endpoint to retrieve available filter options (/api/filters)
5. Ensure filters can be combined with search queries and pagination
6. Optimize query performance for filtered results
7. Add count of available products for each filter option

Testing approach:
- Test filtering with single and multiple filter selections
- Verify filters work correctly when combined with search
- Test edge cases like filtering with no results
- Validate performance of complex filter combinations
- Ensure filter counts are accurate

subtasks.title: Build Product Browsing and Search Frontend Components
subtasks.description: Create responsive frontend components for product browsing, search interface, and filter controls
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Develop a product grid/list component with toggle between views
2. Create a search bar component with auto-suggestions
3. Implement filter sidebar/dropdown components for categories and vendors
4. Add pagination controls with page size selection
5. Create sort controls for different sorting options
6. Implement loading states and empty state handling
7. Ensure responsive design with grid adjustments for different screen sizes
8. Add animations for loading and filtering transitions

Testing approach:
- Test components across different screen sizes
- Verify UI state handling (loading, empty, error states)
- Test keyboard navigation and accessibility
- Validate filter and search interactions
- Test component rendering performance with large datasets

subtasks.title: Implement Product Detail View
subtasks.description: Create a comprehensive product detail page showing all product information and related products
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a product detail API endpoint (/api/products/{id})
2. Develop a responsive product detail page layout
3. Implement image gallery with zoom functionality
4. Add product information sections (description, specifications, pricing)
5. Create a related/similar products component

- Verify image gallery functionality on different devices
- Test breadcrumb navigation paths
- Validate related products recommendations
- Test responsive layout across screen sizes
- Ensure all product information is displayed correctly

tasks.title: Implement Shopping Cart and Checkout
tasks.description: Build shopping cart management and multi-vendor checkout process with payment integration.
tasks.details: Design and implement shopping cart data model. Create API endpoints for cart management. Develop multi-vendor checkout process. Integrate with payment gateway for secure transactions. Build frontend components for cart management and checkout flow. Implement order creation upon successful payment. Create order confirmation notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test adding/removing items from cart. Verify multi-vendor checkout process. Test payment processing with test credentials. Ensure proper order creation after successful payment.

subtasks.title: Design and implement shopping cart data model
subtasks.description: Create the database schema and models for the shopping cart system that supports multi-vendor products
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design database schema for cart items with fields: id, user_id, product_id, vendor_id, quantity, price, created_at, updated_at
2. Create a Cart model that aggregates cart items by user
3. Implement relationships between Cart, CartItem, Product, and User models
4. Add methods for calculating subtotals per vendor and cart total
5. Include validation rules for quantity limits and product availability
6. Create database migrations
7. Write unit tests for the cart model methods
8. Test with different scenarios: adding items, updating quantities, removing items

subtasks.title: Develop API endpoints for cart management
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints to handle all cart operations
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create routes for cart operations: GET /cart, POST /cart/items, PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id
2. Implement controller methods for each endpoint:
   - Fetch cart contents
   - Add item to cart
   - Update item quantity
   - Remove item from cart
   - Clear entire cart
3. Add authentication middleware to protect cart endpoints
4. Implement request validation for all inputs
5. Add error handling for common scenarios (product unavailable, quantity limits)
6. Create API documentation
7. Write integration tests for each endpoint
8. Test concurrent cart operations for race conditions

subtasks.title: Build frontend cart management components
subtasks.description: Develop UI components for displaying and managing the shopping cart
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a CartContext for state management
2. Build CartItem component to display individual items with quantity controls
3. Implement CartSummary component showing totals per vendor and overall
4. Add CartIcon component with item count for navigation bar
5. Create CartPage component for full cart management
6. Implement add/remove/update quantity functionality with API integration
7. Add loading states and error handling
8. Style components according to design system

subtasks.title: Implement multi-vendor checkout process logic
subtasks.description: Create the backend logic to handle checkout process with multiple vendors
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design checkout data model with order grouping by vendor
2. Create checkout initialization endpoint that validates cart items and availability
3. Implement logic to split orders by vendor while maintaining a single checkout session
4. Add inventory reservation during checkout process
5. Create checkout session timeout and inventory release mechanism
6. Implement shipping calculation per vendor
7. Add tax calculation logic
8. Create checkout summary generation with breakdown by vendor
9. Write unit tests for order splitting and calculation logic
10. Test edge cases like partial inventory availability

subtasks.title: Integrate with payment gateway

subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Research and select appropriate payment gateway with multi-vendor support
2. Create payment service abstraction layer
3. Implement payment initialization endpoint that creates payment intent/session
4. Add webhook endpoint for payment confirmations and failures
5. Implement client-side payment form integration
6. Add security measures (HTTPS, input sanitization, etc.)

8. Implement error handling for payment failures

subtasks.title: Build checkout flow UI components
subtasks.description: Develop the frontend components for the complete checkout process
subtasks.details:

2. Build CheckoutContext for state management across steps
3. Implement ShippingForm component with address validation
4. Create VendorOrderSummary component showing items grouped by vendor

subtasks.title: Implement order creation and confirmation system

subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create Order and OrderItem models with appropriate statuses
2. Implement order creation logic triggered by successful payment
3. Add database transaction handling to ensure data consistency
4. Create order confirmation email templates for customers
5. Implement vendor notification system for new orders
6. Add order history endpoint for customer account
7. Create order details page showing status and items
8. Implement order receipt generation

tasks.title: Create Order Management System
tasks.description: Develop order tracking and management functionality for both vendors and customers.
tasks.details: Design and implement order data models. Create API endpoints for order management and status updates. Develop vendor order dashboard with status update capabilities. Build customer order history and tracking interface. Implement basic sales overview for vendors. Create email notifications for order status changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test order creation and status updates. Verify vendors can view and manage their orders. Ensure customers can track their order status and view order history.

subtasks.title: Design and implement order data models
subtasks.description: Create database schema and models for orders, order items, order statuses, and related entities
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design database schema for orders with fields like order_id, customer_id, vendor_id, total_amount, created_at, updated_at
2. Create order_items table with fields like order_id, product_id, quantity, price
3. Design order_status table with status types (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, canceled)
4. Implement model classes with appropriate relationships
5. Add validation rules for order creation
6. Write database migrations
7. Create seed data for testing

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for model validations and relationships
- Test database queries for retrieving orders with different filters
- Verify proper cascade behavior for related entities

subtasks.title: Implement order status workflow and API endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for order CRUD operations and status transitions with proper authorization
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Define order status transition rules (e.g., pending → processing → shipped → delivered)
2. Create API endpoints for:
   - Creating new orders (POST /api/orders)
   - Retrieving order details (GET /api/orders/{id})
   - Updating order information (PUT /api/orders/{id})
   - Changing order status (PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status)
   - Canceling orders (DELETE /api/orders/{id})
3. Implement authorization middleware to ensure vendors can only access their orders
4. Add input validation for all endpoints
5. Create service layer for order business logic

Testing approach:
- API tests for each endpoint with different user roles
- Test status transition validations
- Test error handling for invalid inputs
- Verify authorization rules are enforced

tasks.title: Build Market Day Management
tasks.description: Implement scheduling system for market days with notifications and inventory requirements.
tasks.details: Design and implement market day scheduling data model. Create API endpoints for market day management. Develop notification system for market day reminders. Build frontend components for market day schedule viewing. Implement inventory update requirements for vendors before market days. Create admin interface for managing market day schedules.
tasks.testStrategy: Test market day creation and scheduling. Verify notifications are sent appropriately. Ensure vendors can update inventory for upcoming market days.

subtasks.title: Design and implement market day scheduling data model
subtasks.description: Create the database schema and models for market day scheduling, including date, location, operating hours, vendor participation, and inventory requirements.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Design database schema with tables for MarketDay (id, date, location, start_time, end_time, status, etc.), VendorParticipation (market_day_id, vendor_id, status, etc.), and InventoryRequirement (market_day_id, product_category, minimum_quantity, etc.)
2. Implement model classes with appropriate relationships
3. Create database migrations
4. Add validation rules for date/time constraints and business rules
5. Write unit tests for model relationships and validation
6. Document the data model for other developers

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for model validation rules
- Tests for relationship integrity between models
- Test edge cases like market day cancellations

subtasks.title: Implement API endpoints for market day CRUD operations
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting market days, including vendor participation management.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create controller for MarketDay with endpoints for:
   - GET /api/market-days (list all)
   - GET /api/market-days/{id} (get details)
   - POST /api/market-days (create new)
   - PUT /api/market-days/{id} (update existing)
   - DELETE /api/market-days/{id} (cancel/delete)
2. Create controller for VendorParticipation with endpoints for:
   - GET /api/market-days/{id}/vendors (list participants)
   - POST /api/market-days/{id}/vendors (add vendor)
   - DELETE /api/market-days/{id}/vendors/{vendor_id} (remove vendor)
   - PUT /api/market-days/{id}/vendors/{vendor_id} (update status)
3. Implement request validation
4. Add authentication and authorization checks
5. Create response serializers/transformers

Testing approach:
- API integration tests for each endpoint
- Authorization test cases
- Input validation test cases

subtasks.title: Develop inventory requirement system for market days
subtasks.description: Build functionality to define, track, and enforce inventory requirements for vendors participating in market days.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create API endpoints for inventory requirements:
   - GET /api/market-days/{id}/inventory-requirements
   - POST /api/market-days/{id}/inventory-requirements
   - PUT /api/market-days/{id}/inventory-requirements/{id}
   - DELETE /api/market-days/{id}/inventory-requirements/{id}
2. Implement logic to check vendor inventory against requirements
3. Create a service to validate if vendors meet requirements for participation
4. Build a notification mechanism to alert vendors of unmet requirements
5. Implement a dashboard view for vendors to see their inventory status relative to requirements
6. Add reporting functionality for admins to see compliance across vendors

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for inventory validation logic
- Integration tests for requirement enforcement
- Test scenarios with various inventory levels

subtasks.title: Implement notification system for market day reminders

subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Design notification templates for different event types:
   - Market day announcement
   - Reminder (1 week before)
   - Last call reminder (1 day before)
   - Inventory requirement alert
   - Schedule change/cancellation
2. Implement notification service with support for multiple channels (email, SMS, in-app)
3. Create scheduled jobs to trigger notifications at appropriate times
4. Build preference settings for vendors to control notification frequency and channels
5. Implement notification history tracking
6. Add admin interface to manually trigger notifications

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for notification generation
- Integration tests with mock notification services
- End-to-end tests for scheduled notifications
- Test notification preferences and opt-outs

subtasks.title: Build admin interface for market day schedule management

subtasks.details:

- Cross-browser compatibility testing

7. Test the integration with the actual email provider in a staging environment

- Integration test with actual email provider in staging
- Verify email delivery to test accounts
